notes: Unmeasured template: deliberately rejected. Populate update, startup and checkpoint times from retained qualified real-data profiles. Forecast $3.79 is separate from the live provider quote. Four-hour sessions include measured startup, the shutdown reserve, periodic saves and extra saves at session boundaries. Enter the actual regional GiB-month storage price, measured current usage, expected additional artifacts and retention horizon; the docs example price is not a quote. fixed_cost_usd includes all spending so far and other nonstorage costs; future storage is computed separately. The calibration_report supplies all evaluation durations and task deadline bounds from hashed component evidence. Set experiment_identity.code_commit and container_image_id. Completed training records require group, training_seed, optimizer_updates and checkpoint_dir. Completed evaluation records require group, training_seed (null for reference), num_steps, suite and manifest_path; optionally task_id and task_log_path for a validated 50-episode task. Suite/task overlaps are rejected. Invoke --select-study --study-lock /data/experiments/reports/study_lock.json; the first affordable full/pilot choice and identity cannot change later. No shortened training or omitted tasks.
